questions.stem: During the electrolysis of sodium chloride solution (brine), what is produced at the cathode?
questions.explanation: Sodium is more reactive than hydrogen, so hydrogen ions (H⁺) from water are discharged at the cathode instead of sodium ions. The half-equation is 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ → H₂. Sodium ions remain in solution and combine with hydroxide ions to form sodium hydroxide (NaOH).
